results.title: Emmerhout
results.overview: In the 1970s, in Emmen, Drenthe, the visionary neighbourhood Emmerhout was built. It was designed to be a revolutionary experiment, the neighbourhood of the future. Casper, 52, has been living in Emmerhout for more or less his entire life. In this short documentary, he reflects on past, present and future of the neighbourhood, but also of himself.

results.title: And They Shall Handle Serpents
results.overview: A deranged takeout delivery driver, hoping to lead the wayward home to the Father, makes a terrifying adjustment to their orders.

results.title: Backwoods Blood Feud
results.overview: A group of criminals on the run in a cold, winter forest find themselves caught in the middle of an ancient feud between the monsters that rule the day and the creatures that rule the night.

results.title: Liinakhamari
results.overview: An inspector from the capital arrives in a village in the Arctic Circle to investigate a case of theft. However, not everyone is interested in seeing the investigation through to the end.

results.title: La Scala: The Name Of The Rose
results.original_title: La Scala: The Name Of The Rose
results.overview: Captured live from Milan, Damiano Michieletto world premiere production of Francesco Filidei's new opera, based on Umberto Eco's medievel thriller.

results.title: The Greatest AI Commercial Ever Made
results.original_title: The Greatest AI Commercial Ever Made
results.overview: It is structured as a grand, fever-dream-like fantasy and historical epic. It depicts prehistoric humans discovering steel from a meteorite that gives rise to the first straight razor—an object said to have created "manhood" and carried humanity through historical adventures—until a "bearded philosopher" casts the blade aside.

results.title: The Preservers
results.overview: Four weary rebels of an inhuman regime desperately gather to preserve the most outlawed contraband of all: joy, laughter and stories of those they lost who made them feel human.

results.title: O Roubo do Cão
results.overview: Luciana and her Chihuahua, Rita Lee, are best friends. After the little dog catches Cristal's attention, Luciana must face a group of bumbling criminals hired to steal her.

results.title: Beauty
results.overview: A moving and suspenseful tale of a father's unshakable love. When his daughter suddenly goes missing, his world is turned upside down. What begins as a desperate search soon becomes a gripping journey filled with questions of trust, innocence, and the true meaning of unconditional love. A film that belongs to everyone, Beauty explores a parent's relentless hope and the lengths they will go to for their child.

results.title: The Gift
results.overview: Desi, Samara, and Aurora, three Roma women, go down to the city center to buy a gift for one of their niece's children.

results.title: The Wake
results.overview: The Wake is an anxiety-driven dark comedy that cleverly intertwines elements of farce with an underbelly filled with guilt and familial trauma.

results.title: Who Witnessed The Temples Fall
results.overview: Chorrojumo’s body in ruins has been wandering silently through the streets of Granada for one hundred and eighty-three years. Under the scorching sun, he waits, with his hand raised, for some currency. The infinite limbo in which he lives is interrupted with the arrival of a young Moroccan who brings an ancient key in his hands. Together they begin a search through the Ruins, spaces that have disappeared or are in transition, of present-day Granada, in search of the house of the young man’s ancestors; the last expelled Moriscos, of whom he still retains memories.

results.title: We Are the Fruits of the Forest
results.original_title: Nous Sommes les Fruits de la Forêt
results.overview: The Indigenous Bunong practice agriculture by hand and end up in conflict with Cambodia's lucrative trade in CO2 certificates, losing the forest of whose ownership they have no conception. Now and then, split screen. A visual firework display.

results.title: The Class Reunion
results.overview: While an irate Principal Washington waits for the maintenance man to arrive, the five classmates from different social classes are reluctant to entertain one another. Never crossing paths in high school, the sudden lock-in forces the once jock, nerd, popular girl, teen mom, and delinquent to interact. After a decade of tensions, old beefs resurface, secrets are exposed, and tears are shed as Tia, Nate, Cherry, Jade, and Saint pass time, realizing they aren’t as dissimilar as their statuses projected.

results.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Chrome Alone 2 - Lost in New Jersey
results.original_title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Chrome Alone 2 - Lost in New Jersey
results.overview: When a mysterious toy company seeks to profit off the turtles' new hero status, the brothers follow the clues to New Jersey and make a shocking discovery in this all new original short.

results.title: Silence
results.overview: Three sisters confront a secret when cleaning up the apartment of their deceased father.

results.title: Do You See Her?
results.overview: Katie questions her sanity as she's being stalked by a terrifying entity—one she can only see when her glasses are off.

results.title: Affordable Solutions for a Better Life
results.original_title: Preiswerte Lösungen für ein besseres Leben
results.overview: A new home, a promotion, a loving partner. Anna has everything she could wish for, and yet, the gradual inevitability of things begins to create a pressure within her that she can no longer bear. But where does Anna escape to when her life seems pretty much complete? Into housing complexes that swallow their residents like a beehive? Into labyrinthine furniture stores filled with endless room displays? Or into the life of a missing woman who looks just like her and works at an IKEA store?

results.title: Ouroboros
results.overview: A recently unemployed young woman accepts a job as a waitress at a high-class private party. At the event, she faces numerous situations that take her night in unexpected turns.
